notes.title: A HOTFIX
notes.content: EGGWIFE GHOSTIES WERENT WORKING CORRECTLY. NOW THEY ARE.

We mostly took a break over the last month, but decided to sit down and polish up some stuff we had ready to go! Here's the full list, with the fun/important stuff in bold.


 Factory Ruins is now playable, or at least half of it is. You can get to it by going to Level Select on the Main Menu, or naturally by completing Factory.
 Enemies that bounce from trampolines will now yeet very intently towards the player.
 Fixed PISSCO boss loot falling down his toilet hole.
 Hopefully fixed being able to skip the entirety of Sewer Depths lol.
 Fixed being able to exit the world from Sewer Depths end bowl.
 Fixed toilet water being interactable.
 Tweaks to fire spreading.
 Nerfed flamethrower immediate projectile damage from 4 to 1.5.
 Fixed (again) the giant poo blockage in sewer being insertable.
 Fixed sewer trip-entry door not savegaming.
 Fixed pooping man in sewer showers not pooping.
 Fixed shitting out two shits for the price of one if you just put one back in your ass.
 Fixed not being able to cook dildos.
 Improvements to trampoline park arena.
 Added toolbox quest item, a requirement for building turrets. One will last forever.
 Fixed Pisstol having all the same material on its body.
 Fixed bounty drop sounds coming from world origin.
 Fixed now being able to pick up your security turrets by the body.
 Fixed colliding with some props after they're broken.
 Shopping carts are now drivable.
 Fixed security cameras sometimes causing slowdowns when they dont have a target but are angry.
 Various fixed to weather system.
 Changes to controls (like USE, GRAB, PISS, and KICK, etc.) should reflect correctly in their on-screen prompts. If you see any we've missed, LET US KNOW.
 Added working controls menu to Main Menu.
 Fixed some buttons on Main Menu submenus not being clickable.
 Fixed Book control prompts clipping outside of their widget.
 Hopefully fixed level restarts giving you 1HP and 0 poo.
 Level and Total timers are now clearly distinguishable, are a little tidier, and include milliseconds.

Notable stuff!!!

 Dead security cameras no longer drop their guns, instead their carcasses can be picked up and made into portable turret powerups.
 Significantly changed trampoline arena layout.
 You can now insert certain things in your butt.
 Added "Knotty" difficulty.
 Sewer Depths can be backtracked through a new area.
 Added achievements for finishing levels.
 Text popup on weapon collect now says what the fire modes do.
 Added hair system for humans.
 Flamethrower update: Primary fire sprays the deo, secondary fire lights the lighter. Firing the spray when the lighter is on will ignite the spray. Ignited spray will sustain until you stop firing, even if you turn off the lighter. The little lighter flame can now ignite things that are close to it.
 Fire tweaks: Can now last up to 60 seconds. Every fire has a chance to spawn an ember in a random direction that might set something else on fire. Fire radius slightly raised. Emits light. Probably way laggier than before. Will need more tinkering.
 Dysfunction mode now randomises weapons' projectiles at the beginning of a level.


Other things and fixes!!

 Enemies don't get stuck on trampolines if they're after egg.
 Enemy pathing has been improved across the board.
 Slight alterations to factory cake room.
 Less nailguns to prevent triple weilding early on.
 Added puzzle to Sewer Depths.
 Added squeak to pooge when you use him.
 Fixed rocking chair in farm bedroom not being breakable.
 Added option to toggle crouch.
 Main menu changes: Lighting tweaks, fixed music not looping, gameplay options are now in a drawer.
 TV remote now has use prompts for each button.

 Arcade tweaks.

 Ammo tubs now work with savegames.
 Fixed throw noise happening if you try to throw after putting a plug in a socket.
 Changed the lamps in Pissco.

 Bleach altfire puddles no longer hurt egg.

 Timers won't show in hub levels (ie arcade, level select).

 Poo bounce sound is a little wetter.
 Fan baldes no longer have collision and only update if rendered.
 Updated HUD to reduce hitching.
 Cybermage now has electronicy death explosion.
 Fixed humans leaving behind some hitboxes when gibbed.
 Fixed being able to get hurt by your own vehicle when you exit at speed.
 Fixed being able to get in or out of vehicle while still in the process of getting in or out.
 Cars now have crappy sounds and particle effects.
 Fixed car damage being calculated by wheel speed rather than actual vehicle velocity.
 Decals now more reliable with static lights.
 Fixed shotgun projectiles colliding with egg.
 Made shotgun projectiles more visible.
 Fixed ammo packs colliding with egg.
 Added inventory open and close sound.

notes.title: 0.77.46m
notes.content:
Controls now customisable (currently only accessable from PAUSE menu, not yet included on the main menu).
 Gameplay options menu added:

 Crosshair visibility.
 Crosshair changes colour depending on health.
 Damage indicators.
 Timer visibility.
 Subtitle visibility.
 Crouch toggle (not yet modifiable).
 Decal pool (not yet modifiable - broken).
 Flamethrower now has an alt fire that sprays has without igniting it. Will float in place for 10 seconds and can be ignited as a trap to cause an explosion, or will turn into the regular projectile if sprayed directly on to fire.

 Added "Innocents killed" stat to stats screen.
 Arena cards now have images.
 Fixed PISSCO music being assigned to SFX instead of music.
 Updated the title card artwork.
 Fixed farm level truck not savegaming.
 Better handling of music with savegames.
 Fixed some sewer depths boss stuff.
 Sewer depths piss ice shouldn't break before you reach it.
 Fixed boat being able to get stuck at end of level bowl bit.
 Fixed cows only having one fur colour.
 Cursebow materials fixed.
 Fixed wood materials reverting to default UE4.
 Teleporters now play a sound effect.
 Crossbowner bounce has a new sound.
 Poo meter shakes and egg does a dry fart if you try to poo or double jump when empty.
 Eggwife voice lines updated.
 HUD powerup icons updated to stack from the right.
 Hard difficulty is a bit harder.
 Updated arcade to have separate rooms for arena modes and bonus levels.
 Damplamp appears on the HUD as a powerup if you have it.
 Damage indicator numbers are smaller and stay visible longer.

 Can be lit by any fire damage.

 Fixed "Vampirism" arena card giving the player health when any pawn hurts an enemy.

 Factory conveyor bit is slightly less frustrating.
 Added "Enemy is selecting" and "You are selecting" to the card picking UI in arena mode.
 Added epilepsy warning.
 Added Discord link to main menu.
 Factory end level now takes the player to the arcade rather than Sheffie.

notes.title: 0.77.45m
notes.content:
Improvements to speech bubbles.
 Fixed dazed particles not appearing on some enemies.
 Potentially fixed enemy kill count tracking wrong.
 Music added to arena mode.
 Fixed high shadow mode making the cow intestines unplayably foggy.
 Made vomiting quieter.
 "Charlie" arcade game fixes.
 Football cheering in Sheffie is now spacialised.
 Football in Sheffie now tracks if the player scored a goal rather than an NPC.
 "Back To Arcade" button is now "To Arcade".
 Pause menu compatible with more screen ratios.
 Objects thrown, kicked, or hit with melee will inflict damage if they go on to hit something else.
 Uddersphere powerup now sticks to the player.
 Fixed shopping trolleys not being grabbable.
 Added throw sound.
 Object throw force is more uniform, regardless of mass.
 Added an actually-fun drivable car to Sheffie.
 Gibbing a human deletes their skeletal mesh torso.
 Lamp posts now break on damage.
 Added a bin.
 Fixed humans being able to gib multiple times sometimes.
 Playground in Sheffie updated to look and feel more like a park.
 Tornado fight out-of-bounds area tightened.
 Tornado fight can now be pacifisted by surviving long enough.
 Small testicles now fire at a higher rate.
 Fixed milkigun projectile collision being visible.
 Factory blender and ending room tweaks.
 Glass particles are larger and more visible.
 Breaking a window spawns more glass particles.
 Fixed not being able to pick up stuck some Applicator tampons and Crossbowner bolts.
 Pootank buffed from 200HP to 300HP.
 Nails buffed from 8 damage to 10.
 Single Nailgun fire rate nerfed from 20/sec to 18/sec.
 Sewer boat now uses the new vehicle physics.
 Sewer boat section vastly improved.
 Updated controls "menu" to display more current controls.
 Added healer cultists to arena mode.
 Added flame pootanks to arena mode.
 More sound effect loudness and spaciality fixes.
 Added rudimentary gameplay options menu (currently only in pause menu, not main menu).
 Fixed Crossbowner not showing correct materials on some elements.
 Fireworks packs no longer explode on player respawn if they were destroyed before.
 Fog, thunderstorms, rain, and sunlight states are all saved using a new weather managing system.
 Cow intestines are more gross.
 Fixed computer passwords not savegaming.
 Fixed explosions blocking other explosions from doing damage lmao.
 Sewer Depths drainage bit is now savegamed.
 Disfunction mode no longer breaks the main menu.
 Fixed arcade coins not coming to the arcade with you depending on how you go there.
 Tweaks to arcade geometry and path data.
 Shitgun tooltip is more useful.
 Fixed being able to move the view around when in weapon wheel.
 Added more flash drives to arcade.
 Coal-hole is now behind a shutter door that saves and makes noise when opening.
 Double jumping no longer replaces upward momentum, instead adding to it (if your momentum is higher than momentum given by the double jump).
 Hurty liquid puddles are now deleted on load game.
 Cybermage no longer loses limbs except head.
 Tweaks to farm invisible walls.
 Egg's poos are bigger.
 Poo decals are more pooey.
 Kill taunts are now on a 5-8 second reset timer, then a 1/2 chance of happening, rather than a 1/3 chance of happening always.
 FOV should now save and transfer from level to level properly.
 Various important gameplay objects can no longer be burnt.
 Fixed cows not triggering kill taunts.
 Audio settings should now save and load properly.

notes.title: 0.77.43g
notes.content:
Arcade is now open!!: Currently only accessible by physically going to it in Sheffield (to access the arcade after leaving Sheffield, you'll need to complete the demo which will plop you back into Sheffield, sorry - will be updated to be accessible from all Pause menus and Main Menu in the next update. Not all machines are implemented yet, even if you can get their coins, but some are. Puke Spukum and Streetlevel are playable. leaving the arcade building through the front doors will put you back to your last save (which will currently always be Sheffie bc that's the only way there obv)
 Arcade coins now have an inventory icon.
 Inventory icons now carry sub-icons when applicable (arcade coins show a mini graphic for their level, user manuals show a mini graphic for their gun, etc).
 Non-self speech bubbles now use a different system for how they appear on screen. Still buggy, but should be on the right track.
 Computer cases are static and have a rear texture.
 Replaced a few stock textures in Sheffie with our own (grass, stone bricks)
 All Crossbowner bolts (excluding alt fire bolts which disintegrate) and Applicator tampons can be picked up again, regardless of if they are stuck in something.
 Cleaned up some janky collision on Applicator tampons and Crossbowner bolts.
 Fixed PISSCO wife not saving state.
 Fixed Tampon Helicopter stab sounds not being spatialised.
 Tampon Helicopter and toilet paper now have more accurate colour changes when they absorb a liquid.
 Fixed PISSCO Boss computer not being plugged in.
 Enemies should delete decal puddles that are stuck to them if they're large enough to project on anything other than their body. This seems to be inconsistent but a slight improvement.
 Detached limbs spray an extra arc of blood behind them.
 Liquid spurts should now leave a few less sideways decals.
 Fixed human mouth hitboxes blocking explosions and liquid spurts.
 Milkigun tweaks: spread tightened, projectile hitboxes smaller. as it was near impossible to fire through gaps and they would often collide with geometry before reaching target.
 Milk puddles no longer look like paint.
 Mage renamed to Cybermage, updated colour scheme, survives decapitation and projects sparks.
 Fertilauncher explosions particle reduced a little in duration and their smoke rises.
 Fixed humans surviving decapitation by default if the damage inflicted wasn't enough to kill them.
 Fixed factory cow blender showing USE prompt all over the mesh.
 Fixed the Cowveyor in Factory having wrongly placed cow and being able to be multi-triggered into oblivion (its still buggy when loading game though, but not critically so).
 Factory weed room can now be pacifisted, and therefor all of the currently available content can too.
 Factory weed room entry and exit doors now work with saves.
 Buffed nail damage a little.
 Enemies summoned in now play a sound effect.
 Nerfed PISSCO secrets to not contain so many weapons.
 Fixed a few enemy navigation tough spots in Sewer.
 Fixed shutter doors not blocking explosions.
 Explosive barrels of all kinds and fire extinguishers now carry across their instigator (meaning if you blow up a barrel and the explosion kills something, it was your fault).
 Wall cracks now carry their instigator through to all explosions they set off (same as above).
 Key pickups now have a square hitbox instead of the exact key shape.
 Overhauled the way music is handled: Tracks are now stored with their title, artist, and key. The current music is now displayed (song + artist) in the TAB and ESC menus.
 Current music is now savegamed.
 Fixed a number of uncategorised sounds.
 Cows should now save their "possessed" state.
 Fixed a couple of elevators pushing you out of the world.
 Killed a few more default fonts floating around.
 Fixed being able to accidentally speedrun the apartment.
 Graphics menu contains a few more options. DO NOT USE THE HIGH SHADOW SETTING, IT FUCKS UP SOME FOG AREAS MAKING THEM UNPLAYABLE
 Graphics options should more reliably save. I think?
 Fixed fire turning some objects to default texture instead of burnt texture.
 Keys used on a keycard reader no longer have collision.
 Arcade coins are easier to pick up and use a different sound.
 Fixed boss areas restarting their music and ending sound even if they've been completed if you re-enter them after a load game.
 Boss areas now stop their music if you leave them, and restart it if you come back when the boss is alive.
 Leaving a boss area without killing the boss will no longer play the "battle won" sound.
 Added Japanese Pooge and Gamer pooge to arcade.
 Fixed cubicle door unlock sound being unspatialised.
 Fixed Quit Game button on pause menu being unclickable.
 "Back to Sheffie" button in Pause menu on bonus levels is now "Back to Arcade".
 Pause menu now has a trippy background and is blurred.
 Fixed a couple of vending machines not giving items.
 Flash drives no longer save the game on pickup.
 77p Studios relocated from Sheffie main level to the Arcade level.

notes.title: 0.77.42h
notes.content:
Cake-baking section in Factory overhauled: now functions as intended instead of requiring a placeholder cake recipe. All machinery in the room functions, allowing for pacifist\vegan approach.
 Fixed all human types taking double damage when point damaged (shot or hit by something).
 Humans now gib when they hit the negative equivalent of their starting health, rather than the previous value of -50.
 Added Mage.
 Flamethrower Pootanks now actually work lol.
 Liquid puddles should now persist when loading a game/respawning.
 Explosions now use their own visibility channel, and should now damage enemies (and you) through other enemies and most small props.
 Inventory tabs are now renamed ALL ITEMS - POWERUPS - WEAPONS - INFO (previously [ALL - COLLECTABLES - POWERUPS - WEAPONS - MISC]) and items have been recategorised to hopefully make more sense.
 Explosive septic shit barrels now use liquid particles instead of liquid blobs, and are somewhat more deadly. Septic shit barrel enemies have not been updated to use this.
 Fixed wrongly-oriented damplamp on some weapons.
 Fixed a number of sounds being unaffected by volume sliders.
 Fixed guitar being able to deal damage before the draw animation is finished.
 Used toilet paper now spawns in front of you after you've wiped.
 Fixed currently-equipped weapon not being remembered between level transitions/respawns/game loads.
 Fixed elevators not saving their state.
 Boomer Juice now has correct inventory icon.
 Fixed being able to fire when the weapon wheel is active.
 Added Quick Load button (hard set to F9 for now).
 Fixed cows having a much smaller hitbox with some weapons.
 Fixed cows leaving a unanimated mesh behind when burned.
 Changed the way ceiling light blueprints cast shadows, if they are set to do so.
 Pisstol finally has an updated icon.
 Piss ammo no longer uses a stock piss drop icon.
 Added book to apartment to teach about weapon alt fires. Maybe it'll teach more later.
 Fixed mirrors being very dark.
 Fixed world UI elements blocking enemy sightlines.
 Humans, Pissfaces, and Pootanks now try their best to not intersect each other.

Fixed shutter doors not saving their position.
 Broken windows now leave broken glass in their frame.
 Factory level now has a proper ending, but still needs tweaks.
 Made Guitar Plus Centre a little more obvious.
 Sewer depths underwater sequence is now a little more tense.
 Nerfed Soul Eggs (the little auto-pickup health bonuses dropped by dead enemies) to give about half of what they would before.
 Testicle boss now drops correct soul egg.
 Regular testicle now drops correct soul egg.
 Fixed tampon heli stab sound not being spacialised.
 (Hopefully) fixed electronic objects sometimes not starting powered despite being plugged in.
 Electronic objects now correctly save if they are unplugged during play or plugged into a different socket.
 Added the rudimentary beginnings of a slightly buggy weapon wheel, currently bound to holding N or CAPS.
 Cultists now play a sound when they shoot their magic balls.
 Footballers in Sheffie no longer leave the football match.
 Football match in Sheffie is somewhat functional.
 Added a couple of new optional tutorial books to the apartment.
 Books now have a fullbright paper texture for better reading in poor lighting.
 JumpPads no longer add velocity to your existing velocity, instead hard-set it.
 Apartment level is now fully backtrackable.
 Humans will now delete their boobs if they are male.
 Added a new cultist enemy type.
 Buffed Fertilauncher alt-fire.
 Added world-space versions of our custom fonts.
 Started slowly weeding out instances of the default UE4 font.
 All nail projectiles (both regular and the ones that fly out of the nailbomb) have a 1/4 chance of being a tracer round.
 Bong inventory tooltip now mentions the health boost it gives you.

General improvements to enemy detection. A little.
 Adjustments to trampoline park arena map.
 Extended the beginning of the hidden level.
 Made piss a little less luminous.
 The blender will no longer delete egg.
 Fixed no collision on minecart in Sheffie.
 Hopefully, the game has an actual icon now in your taskbar, desktop, whatever.
 Pootanks now have a searchlight.
 Improved arena card selection process.
 All arena enemies should be immediately aware of egg on spawn.
 Arena cards now show when they are stackable.
 You can now enter a seed for arena mode.
 Hidden level changed.
 Fixed all enemy spawners insta-aggro-ing on egg.
 Potentially fixed a rare bug where Pootanks wouldn't register as dead.
 Guitar no longer gives you FertiLauncher ammo.
 Fixed a vending machine not giving you brown water.
 Egg's speech bubble better shows both long and short dialog. Sometimes it bugs out tho.
 PISSCO front doors joke now has to be looked at before egg comments on it.
 Fixed Little Shits leaving behind collision boxes after death.
 Arena out-of-lives menu no longer mentions difficulty.
 "Recoil In Fear" arena card also increases spread.
 Flash drives and arcade coins are now static objects.
 Fixed a broken secret area on Farm.
 Fixed enemies not dropping bounties.
 Arcade coins no longer save game on pickup.
 Can no longer eat the magic mushroom before reaching the applicable save point.
 Fixed liquid blobs staying in the world for too long if they hit their instigator, or have none.
 PISSCO boss adjustments to hopefully make him less cheese-able.
 Glass now has the glass physical material and should spawn sounds and particles when shot.
 Nailbomb now has a trail.
 Nailbomb initial explosion damage is lower, but has a larger radius and fires twice as many more nails.
 Marked a secret in Sewer Depths as actually secret.
 Crossbowner now carries 35 ammo, up from 26.
 Crossbowner pickup gives 10 ammo, up from 3.
 Crossbowner ammo crates fill you up to 35.
 Crossbowner projectiles have a bigger hitbox.
 Fixed terraced houses having too simple a collision model.
 Fixed some voice line volume balance issues.
 Some layout work on Factory.
 Fixed Soul Egg collection radius blocking enemy line-of-sight.
 Flamethrower projectiles don't travel as far so it's not worth trying to use at range.
 Flamethrower projectiles deal less damage on impact so it's not so OP at close range.
 Fire deals more damage over time.
 Adjusted the particle effect on the flamethrower to hopefully feel a bit less random.
 Flamethrower is 4 times more likely to start fires.
 Flamethrower now uses our custom fire texture instead of UE4 default.
 Added the UdderSphere powerup.
 Added some secrets to Farm.
 Cow's anus is fully blocked until you pull out the key.
 Cow is now properly crucified.
 Replaced some default textures on farm with our own.
 Farm sunlight is a bit brighter and casts some shadows and stuff.

notes.title: 0.77.38d
notes.content:
Added level select, accessible via the main menu.
 Sealed multiple holes in staff womb.
 Sealed multiple holes in Sewer.
 Tweaked some weapon placements in PISSCO.
 Added secret area to PISSCO.
 Stocked more shelves in PISSCO.
 More humans in Sheffie, PISSCO, Farm, Factory.
 Fixed an issue where Pissfaces could hear you from very far away and would aggro from across the map.
 Some dirty liquids now have chunks floating in them.
 Fixed Main Menu getting fucked up if you quit from dysfunction difficulty back to it.
 Fixed being able to press 7 multiple times on Main Menu.
 Spacialised some sounds that weren't.
 Respawning will grant you 2 seconds of invulnerability, hopefully assisting in the rare case of getting stuck in a spawn>die loop.
 Crosshair now has a primary and secondary fire indicator if applicable to the current weapon, which light up when clicked.
 Computers are always static and can't be shorted out, regardless of being passworded, for consistency.
 Fixed conveyor belts moving trigger boxes (lol)
 Made the 77p Studios TestLevel arcade machines clearer as to what they do.
 Fixed pathing issues in staff womb.
 Tampon heli now has much better, but still not perfect, pathing.
 Fixed tampon heli staying still after the player dies and respawns.
 Tampon heli now has more health, but takes 3x damage to fire.
 Tampon heli sounds added.
 Tampon heli soaks up the color of any liquid it touches, or the colour of the blood type of an entity it stabs.
 Fixed some unbaked lighting in Sewer Depths.
 Making a human vomit will fully immobilise them for some seconds.
 Hitbox for making a human vomit increased.
 Added vomit sounds to human.
 Decreased the amount of time in which a human can start vomiting again after finishing.
 Fixed version number appearing twice.
 Added Factory after Farm. It's still quite unfinished but that's what you're here to help us do.
 Factory conveyor puzzle is faster.
 Damage stats in the TAB screen for some weapons should be better represented.

notes.title: 0.77.37a
notes.content:
Removed shadow option that was broken
 Pissco boss is now fixed

notes.title: Update 0.77.36RD2
notes.content:
I am absolutely not going to categorise this into "fixes" "features" etc. There's too many and I'm sleepy.
Okay..

One glaring issue right now: The PISSCO boss doesn't puke in built versions of the game. He can still be defeated but it's obviously way more trivial and crappy. We're looking into why this has suddenly decided to happen but it's very frustrato because he works fine in editor, just not here.


 Blood and other liquid particles don't spawn quite as many puddles, but they're now a bit larger.
 Added hit confirmation effect to crosshair + sound.
 Fire and toxic puddles now carry data for who was responsible for spawning them (so hit confirmations work when you burn stuff or hurt stuff with puddles).
 Applicator buffed - 101 base damage, up from 60.
 Humans now have louder and more dynamic gib sounds.
 Crossbowner buffed - Alt fire hit radius increased after first bounce; now carries 26 bolts, up from 16.
 Fixed a number of issues with kicking by moving it over to a projectile-based system.
 New sounds for kicking.
 Fixed some shitty lighting in apartment.
 Supply crates now have 9HP, down from 20HP.
 Sofa cushions don't collide with egg any more.
 Fixed projectiles producing hit emitters even when they're just rolling on the floor. This was very bad lol.
 Plates now just use a static mesh and break into a particle effect instead of the janky breakable mesh system.
 Fixed switch and button sounds not being spacial.
 Fixed sounds getting stuck in slow motion if you die in slow motion but respawn before the slowmo was triggered.
 Locked door jostle sounds that play when you walk into them now also play when the door is shot, kicked, pissed on, etc.
 Moved weapons in apartment in hopes the player will actually pick them up.
 Enemies now use a new trace channel to detect stuff.
 Fixed game being able to be saved after dying.
 Buffed Testicle boss' health.
 Player can no longer receive damage from multiple toxic puddles at once (but enemies still can nyeh heh heh).
 Hard mode now also has infinite lives.
 Fixed some projectile types never despawning.
 Slightly improved volume differences between various music tracks.
 Imported a new options menu from the Epic Store.
 Removed it.
 Shitgun has a little bit of kickback.
 Fixed Sewer piss mixers not saving their on/off state.
 Fixed fire extinguishers not saving their state.
 Fixed having to re-enter special liquid volumes to regain their given effects.
 Cultists will delete their melee prop on death.
 "Press fire to continue" text moved away from the crosshair a bit.
 Fixed some Pissface sounds not being spacialised.
 Changed the colours and scales of Soul Eggs to hopefully better represent their given health values.
 Books are now static.
 Fixed having to press USE twice to read a book. Hopefully.
 Potty Cannon buff - Alt fire tubs now explode into a lot more liquid.
 Fixed Little Shits sometimes still animating after death.
 "Made cum a bit more like cum" - That's what the git commit says okay, I don't remember what I did.
 Fixed screen wobble from vomiting going on for 25 seconds even if the vomit debuff doesn't.
 Reduced vomit debuff from trashcans from 25 to 12 seconds.
 Fixed the pootank that always gets stuck on the Sewer Depths thin hallways.
 Farm level terrain converted to low poly BSP instead of Unreal's terrain system. One bullet point doesn't do justice to how much fucking work this was.
 Added cull distances to various small objects.
 Fixed drinks cans not displaying our given eat messages.
 Milkigun tweaks for optimisation, feel, and effectiveness.
 Humans now gib at -50HP.
 PISSCO Boss improvements (except for the fact that he doesn't fucking function right now): Spawns gore on death. Exposes a pissface on death. Projectiles aim better and have particle effects.
 Nailguns priority swapped.
 Fixed being able to suddenly die in the apartment staff room.
 Sheffie now saves when the intro cutscene finishes.
 Sheffie now has multiple voice lines to remind the player what to do.
 Sheffie has more humans.
 Sheffie now has a guitar shop.
 Fixed Pooges not saving any modified colours, collision profiles, or voice lines.
 Pisstol now displays an infinite symbol in the ammo count.
 Pisstol now has an alt fire that dribbles piss. Mostly the same as regular pissing but goes farther.
 Pisstol buff: Primary fire damaged now 8, up from 4.
 Fire is brighter.
 Added Little Shits to Sewer Depths boss computer room.
 Added a Pisstol in the vent before the PISSCO boss, just in case.
 Lighting is never considered for saving.
 Egg now has one liners for when enemies are killed.
 Fixed projectile emitters getting stuck in walls.
 Message displays when you try to pick up ammo but you're full.
 If a puddle on a ceiling or wall drips, it will spawn another beneath it.
 Fixed showers' water colliding with invisible volumes.
 Fixed Little Shit having a piece of corn that stretches whenever its nose moves.
 Fixed a few invisible volumes that were blocking enemy visibility.
 Pissfaces can see and hear further. This might have been a mistake.
 Sewer 2nd fight room expanded.
 Added some foods.
 FertiLauncher now has an alt-fire that fires mini homing rockets.
 More ammo in farm.
 Cow gibs no longer block visibility or other pawns.
 Partially fixed electronic objects sometimes not saving their state properly.
 Fertilauncher gives 20 ammo instead of 10 on pickup.
 Partially fixed tampon helicopters losing the player and flying away.
 Enemies should less-frequently get stuck inside each other when spawning in a monster closet.
 Fixed a few specific humans walking about when they shouldn't be.
 PooTanks should work more reliably in fight arenas.


Phew.

notes.title: 0.77.33c
notes.content:
FOV will now save between levels (but not between main menu and game whoops
 Removed the hole in the 77p studios office
 Nailgun can now be duel wielded
 Nailgun can now be triple wielded
 Updated some powerups so they actually work as powerups and not used instantly
 Zits will no longer show a kick message when dead
 Conveyer belts no longer show eggs model when he rides on them
 Liquids have been updated to not spam the liquid fill sound
 Fixed water volume in Sewer Depths not being to the top
 Coffee tables now break into debris
 Toilet rolls now give health when used and they aren't used
 HUD is hidden on sheffy cutscene
 Pissfaces hurt on overlap, not on a timer
 Pisstol should auto-equip normally
 Damplamp should now be placed in a better place on some weapons

Fixed farm music being repetitive
 FOV should now go between levels and saves
 You can now select 150% resolution scale on the main menu
 New cursor!
 Various fixes for Farm, SewerDepths, Sewer and Pissco

notes.title: Update notes for 17th May
notes.content:
Added a new model for the cow, full animated and actually challenging!
 Flamethrower now throws less flamey flames
 Enemies should no longer scratch themselves
 Added the flamethrower PooTank
 Updates to secret future levels
 Inventory now has a scoreboard
 Humans will now no longer try to explore some areas that they shouldn't
 New arena cards!
 Added "basically more" shadows option
